name: _header.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_header.scss — the CMS header band and its quick cloud/AI admin
//  bar (deploy, sync, media actions) plus the page-level layout grid.
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── CMS Header & Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-header {
  min-height: $cms-header-min-height;
  background: rgba(15, 20, 28, 0.9);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1rem 2rem;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;

  .cms-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-lg);
    cursor: pointer;

    .cms-logo {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: var(--space-2xs);
      color: $cms-accent;
    }

    .cms-badge {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md);
      background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.15);
      color: $cms-accent;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      letter-spacing: var(--space-hairline);
    }
  }

  // ── Quick Cloud & AI Admin Bar ─────────────────────────────────────
  .cms-quick-tools {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin: 0.4rem 0;

    .cms-dropdown {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;

      &:hover .cms-dropdown-menu,
      &:focus-within .cms-dropdown-menu {
        opacity: 1;
        visibility: visible;
        transform: translateY(0);
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
    }

    .cms-quick-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-sm);
      background: rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.7);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: $cms-text-primary;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;

      .cms-btn-icon {
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

      .cms-caret {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        color: $cms-text-subtle;
        transition: transform 0.2s ease;
      }

      &:hover {
        background: rgba(45, 58, 74, 0.9);
        border-color: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.4);
        color: $color-white;

        .cms-caret {
          color: $cms-accent;
          transform: rotate(180deg);
        }
      }

      &--ai {
        background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.12);
        border-color: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.35);
        color: $cms-accent;

        &:hover {
          background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.22);
          box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.25);
        }
      }

      &--bucket {
        &:hover {
          border-color: $cms-badge-warn;
        }
      }

      &--firebase {
        &:hover {
          border-color: $cms-badge-amber;
        }
      }

      &--billing {
        &:hover {
          border-color: $cms-badge-green;
        }
      }
    }

    .cms-dropdown-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 0;
      min-width: $cms-dropdown-min-width;
      background: $cms-bg-card;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 0.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
      z-index: 1000;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-xs);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(var(--space-xs));
      transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        transform 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s ease;
      pointer-events: none;

      &::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(-1 * var(--space-md));
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        height: var(--space-md);
      }

      .cms-dropdown-item {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--space-md);
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        color: $cms-text-primary;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
        transition: all 0.15s ease;
        cursor: pointer;

        .item-icon {
          font-size: 1rem;
        }

        &:hover {
          background: rgba(102, 252, 241, 0.15);
          color: $cms-accent;
          transform: translateX(var(--space-xs));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  .cms-user-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;

    .cms-avatar {
      width: var(--space-2xl);
      height: var(--space-2xl);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .cms-email {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: $cms-text-muted;
    }

    .cms-logout-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      color: $color-white;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.2s;

      &:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      }
    }
  }
}
